shots.words: At first I thought these were breath mints.
shots.still: Vertical 9:16 photo, a single frame from a phone-shot UGC video. SIZE FIRST: the jar is small, about as wide as a woman's palm; her fingers look normal next to it, the jar never looks bigger than her hand. Close-up on a white counter in a pink-tile bathroom: the real NovaTabz jar: a short wide CLEAR GLASS jar, 2.17 inches wide and 1.65 inches tall (fits in a palm, smaller than a coffee mug), with a threaded glass neck and glass visible above and below a turquoise paper label that wraps its middle. Label front, exactly as image 2, letter for letter and colour for colour: a white rectangle with turquoise capitals TOOTHPASTE TABLETS; below it NOVA over TABZ in big white serif capitals; PEPPERMINT in spaced white capitals; 62 / TABLETS in white on the left; NET WT / 23G / (0.8 OZ) in white on the right. No other words, no ® or ™. It stands open, its lid (a brushed SILVER metal screw lid with a finely ridged side edge and a plain flat top (image 3)) lying beside it, full of plain WHITE round flat tablets with rounded edges, each about the size of an aspirin, no print, no colour, no stripes. Grace's hand exactly as on the hand sheet: medium-brown skin, short squared French-tip nails (pale pink with white tips), a silver crown ring stack on the ring finger, a small gold ring with a heart-shaped stone on the middle finger, a blue silicone band on the thumb, bare wrist with no bracelet and no watch, the whole wrist visible, the hand enters from the frame edge. Her thumb and index finger pinch ONE white tablet just above the open jar. Only one jar. Bright neutral daylight, true colours, clean and fresh, not dark, not yellow. No text, no captions, no watermark. Reference images: image 1 = the product sheet from real photos: copy the clear glass jar, turquoise label, silver lid and white tablets exactly; image 2 = a real close-up of the label print; image 3 = a real photo of the silver lid; image 4 = the real room to use as the background (same colours and light); image 5 = Grace's real hand sheet (skin tone, nails, rings, bare wrist). The jar must match images 1, 2 and 3 exactly in shape, size and colour; the label print matches image 2 letter for letter and colour for colour.
shots.clip: Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its room, light, framing and hand exactly. Image 2 is the real NovaTabz label: the label print matches it letter for letter and colour for colour. Image 3 is the real silver lid. Image 4 is the product sheet: keep this exact clear glass jar, turquoise label and white tablets; no added marks. Motion: the fingers lift the one tablet slowly up toward the lens; the jar stays still on the counter. The hand keeps one grip and the jar never turns, flips or changes shape. The jar does not change size. No music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.
